Well, because when HTMX sends a POST
request, it tries to attach any meaningful
data it can get.
And if that POST request is sent because
some input changes and that input is in a
form,
it turns out that HTMX gathers all the form
data of the entire form.

I wanna attach just the data of this input,
not the entire form data.
So what can we do about that?
Now, you might recall the hx-vals attribute
from earlier in the course, which could be
used to add new data to an outgoing request.
Now, I essentially wanna filter the data
that's added automatically so that not all
the values are added.
And this can be achieved with help of
another HTMX attribute. The hx-params
attribute.
This attribute allows you to filter the
parameters, the values
that will be attached to the outgoing
request.
To be precise, here with hx-params,
you can specify a comma-separated list of
the values that should be added to the
request.
And any other values which you don't specify
here will be dropped and will not be part of
the request.
